definitions: To believe someone's statement or accept their innocence, even when there is some uncertainty or lack of complete proof.
To assume someone is telling the truth or acting with good intentions, rather than being suspicious or critical.
examples: I'll give him the benefit of the doubt this time.
The judge decided to give the defendant the benefit of the doubt.
Despite the inconsistencies, we should give her the benefit of the doubt.
lemma: give someone the benefit of the doubt
source: give someone the benefit of the doubt
